t: What Is Modern Design? A 2025 Guide to This Evolving Style | Apartment Therapy
s: August 24, 2025 - While Arts and Crafts’ dark, heavy furniture and moody botanical wallpaper might seem at odds with what we think of as modern today, this movement towards straight lines and sweeping curves was a first step in the right direction towards modernism. The movement continued to grow as industrialism expanded and the Machine Age set in. From the architectural-inspired lines of Art Deco in the 1920s to the rise of neutral, light, contemporary Scandinavian design in the 1930s and post-World War II, the aesthetic continued to evolve.
